title: Unpinned Brodex dispatch can inherit an unrelated global account label
wanted_capability: An omitted dispatch account should select only the provider's declared default or native credentials, unless account membership is explicitly configured. account_candidates currently enumerates every global account for every provider, allowing Brodex to select an unrelated OpenRouter account. The label may be misleading when its environment has no Brodex effect, but account environment is also applied to the dispatch.
missing_primitive: Provider-scoped implicit account eligibility and tests for omitted-account selection
fallback_used: Inspect the selected account and explicitly pin an intended account when needed.
notes: Reported by operator during MCP contract remediation. Investigate the execution environment separately from the displayed account; no assumption that OpenRouter actually served the request.
resolution_note: Provider-scoped implicit account candidates shipped in 8ccdcd06 and deployed in image 4ffe9430f0e3. Full cluster gate passed 7400 tests. Live Brodex GPT-6 Astra dispatch without account pin returned account=null and completed with MCP_ACCOUNT_SMOKE_OK; provider catalog includes the Astra slug. Explicit account overrides remain supported.
